title: Pregnancy Recipes: Iron-and-Folate Bowls You Can Cook in 30 Minutes
excerpt: Three tasty recipes pairing heme/non-heme iron with vitamin C — Vietnamese-inspired bowls with clear portions and food-safety notes.
content:
## Introduction
During pregnancy, it's essential to provide the body with sufficient iron and folate. Iron helps create red blood cells, while folate supports the development of the fetus. However, finding recipes rich in iron and folate can be a challenge. In this article, we'll introduce three Vietnamese-inspired iron-and-folate bowl recipes that can be cooked in under 30 minutes.

## Nutrient Analysis
Iron and folate are two crucial nutrients for pregnant women. Iron helps prevent anemia, while folate supports the development of the fetus's brain and nervous system. To enhance iron absorption, it's recommended to combine iron-rich foods with vitamin C-rich foods.

## Recipe 1: Grilled Chicken and Vegetable Bowl
* 100g grilled chicken
* 100g white rice
* 50g mixed vegetables (carrots, green beans, broccoli)
* 1 lemon
* Salt, pepper, cooking oil

Grill the chicken with cooking oil and seasonings, then mix with white rice, mixed vegetables, and lemon juice. This recipe provides approximately 10mg of iron and 100mcg of folate.

## Recipe 2: Beef and Water Spinach Stir-Fry Bowl
* 100g beef stir-fry
* 100g white rice
* 50g water spinach
* 1 lemon
* Salt, pepper, cooking oil

Stir-fry the beef with cooking oil and seasonings, then mix with white rice, water spinach, and lemon juice. This recipe provides approximately 15mg of iron and 150mcg of folate.

## Recipe 3: Tofu and Vegetable Bowl
* 100g tofu
* 100g white rice
* 50g mixed vegetables (carrots, green beans, broccoli)
* 1 lemon
* Salt, pepper, cooking oil

Grill the tofu with cooking oil and seasonings, then mix with white rice, mixed vegetables, and lemon juice. This recipe provides approximately 10mg of iron and 100mcg of folate.

## Food Safety Notes
When cooking for pregnant women, it's essential to prioritize food safety. Avoid eating raw or undercooked foods, especially meat, eggs, and seafood. Cook foods to an internal temperature of 74°C (165°F) to ensure safety.

## Conclusion
These three Vietnamese-inspired iron-and-folate bowl recipes can help pregnant women provide their bodies with sufficient nutrients. Combine iron-rich foods with vitamin C-rich foods to enhance iron absorption. For more information on [pregnancy meal planning](/blog/pregnancy-meal-planner), visit our website.

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about prenatal nutrition, consult with your doctor or a registered dietitian. For more information on [prenatal nutrition](/blog/prenatal-nutrition), visit our website.
